**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

The IP rule is satisfied in substance, though by an asset-ownership regime rather than a classic IP article:

- **We own what we pay for.** §4.3 (p0119) and §12.2 (p0187) give ownership of the Wet Segment and Allocated Capacity in proportion to our financial investment per Schedules B and C; §12.16 (p0201) does the same for Unallocated Capacity.
- **The co-ownership is not walk-away joint ownership.** Ownership "in common and undivided shares" is inherent to the consortium, and §12.4–12.27 give us an unrestricted right to exploit — assigning circuits on any Path and selling IRU capacity on bilateral terms.
- **No assignment of our IP or data to the counterparties.** Searches for intellectual property, software, title and grant returned nothing that transfers Teleglobe rights; §31 Confidentiality (p0270–p0273) restricts other Parties' use and disclosure of data we supply.

Noted in the rationale, not flagged: there is no express IP/Customer Data ownership clause or licence-back, since the Wet Segment is procured under a separate Supply Contract with Suppliers (§4.4). That is a gap against the preferred wording only — nothing in the document divests us of IP or data rights, so no redline is warranted.
